newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 lifted by Dow at open, awaits RPI data.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 lifted by Dow at open, awaits RPI data.

text.p: The FTSE 100 rose at Tuesday's opening, tracking a stronger Dow close and higher index futures.
The leading British index was 43.4 points up to 5,075.3 by 0750 GMT, lifted also by big gains for oil majors British Petroleum and Shell . Index futures rose 46 points to 5,108.
An 18p gain to 902p for BP added about six points to the index and a 10p gain for Shell, trading at 450-1/2p, added two points. On Monday, the ADRs of both surged in New York.
A raft of company results took the market's early attention, with profits roughly in line with forecasts.
